title: Galil Engineering
description: galileng.com zoominfo.com/c/galil-engineering/346973568 Galil Group (Y.W. Galil Engineering) is a private, family-owned EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) firm founded in 1984 by Yossi Weiss in Ramat Yishai, Israel, now run jointly by his three sons (Nimrod, Nitzan, and Or Weiss as Co-CEOs/Deputy CEO). It employs ~190–250 people (engineers, technicians, managers) with estimated annual revenue of $50–100M — fully self-funded with no external investors. Over 42 years, Galil has completed full turnkey industrial projects across 8+ countries (Israel, Romania, Croatia, Rwanda, Chile, Botswana, Canada, USA), spanning defense, energy, pharmaceuticals (Teva, Intel), petrochemicals, food, and microelectronics. Key projects include a 344 MW pumped storage plant, a 144 MW dual-fuel cogeneration station, Chile's Aconcagua desalination plant, and Israel's first-ever NGA gasification permit for an industrial site. The company offers 10+ in-house engineering disciplines
